title: StartupBench: Benchmarking General-Purpose Agents on Market-Validated End-to-End Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2608.17800v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models(LLMs) and agents have substantially improved the ability of AI systems to execute complex tasks. Yet existing benchmarks largely rely on researcher-selected tasks, leaving uncertain whether such progress extends to the work that real-world users actually demand from AI systems. We introduce \textbf{StartupBench}, an E2E agent benchmark grounded in market-validated AI startup products. Rather than defining tasks from pre-defined assumptions about useful agent capabilities, we systematically study AI products with demonstrated adoption, together with their product workflows and users, to identify real-world tasks for which AI has established practical demand across diverse professional domains. We translate these workflows into complete deliverable-oriented tasks and evaluate them with fine-grained rubrics capturing their complex requirements. translated_title: StartupBench：在市场验证的端到端工作流上对通用型智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17800v1 公告类型：新 摘要：近年来，大型语言模型（LLMs）和智能体的进展显著提升了AI系统执行复杂任务的能力。然而，现有基准大多依赖于研究者自行选择的任务，这使得我们无法确定这种进步是否能扩展到真实世界用户实际要求AI系统完成的工作。我们引入了\textbf{StartupBench}，一个基于市场验证的AI初创公司产品的端到端智能体基准。我们不是从预设的关于有用智能体能力的假设出发来定义任务，而是系统地研究那些已被证明有实际采用度的AI产品，连同其产品工作流程和用户，以识别AI在多样化专业领域中已建立实际需求的任务。我们将这些工作流程转化为以交付物为导向的完整任务，并通过细粒度的评分标准来评估它们所包含的复杂要求。在统一环境下评估的代表性模型中，我们展示了结果。
tldr: 该论文提出了StartupBench，一个基于市场验证的AI初创公司产品工作流的端到端智能体基准，旨在评估通用型智能体在真实世界需求任务上的表现，而非研究者预设的任务。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces StartupBench, an end-to-end agent benchmark grounded in market-validated AI startup product workflows, to evaluate general-purpose agents on real-world demand tasks rather than researcher-selected tasks.
